positions.title: Associate Product Manager
positions.description:
OPENPATH is a design education brand fostering designer growth through a cycle of knowledge, unlocking limitless potential. We began with offline education, then expanded online, creating a platform to share practical knowledge with a broad designer community.

- Platform Launch & Scaling: Successfully supported the launch and scaling of a new online education platform.
- User Insights & Strategy: Gathered and analyzed user requirements from designers, translating them into comprehensive feature planning and actionable roadmaps for the engineering team.
- Architecture & System Design: Spearheaded the end-to-end architecture and product scoping for both the Admin and Consumer applications.
positions.insights: Skills: PMM · Engineering · Software Product Management · Web Design · Web Development · Product Management

positions.title: Floor director assistant
positions.description:
Back in the day, Stuart Diamond published his highly acclaimed "Getting More." He teaches negotiation for more than 20 years at Wharton. 

SBS has made a request to Mr. Diamond for a lecture on its lecture-style TV show. Soon after he accepted it, I accommodated business meetings and delivered / translated key messages from both sides as a bridge - a couple of conflicts that soon sewed up, and cool insights about how to communicate well.

The members of University Singers develop a high level of choral skill through the study and performance of a wide variety of choral music, covering all historical eras.

projects.title: Snail Post
projects.description:
SnailPost is a mobile communication app designed to bring back the sense of slow, thoughtful satisfaction of snail mail, in an era where most communication is built upon instant gratification. Using this app, you are able to send images and captions to your friends and contacts, which will be delivered to them after a certain delay.

https://github.com/eecs394-f16/SnailChat

projects.title: Every Single Day
projects.description:
Mobile-Web application asking people to bid money to keep their promises for a full week

Implemented Single Page application using React and HTML5 to access native camera, attach photos with texts to upload on News Feeds with social plugins

Established image file uploading/fetching functionality using jQuery and Cloudinary API, enabling synchronous data flow between client and server
